summary: CLI iterations, dimensions and sparsity reach spmvGpu; the initialized CSR has a delimiter per row and final delimiter nItems. The host helper launches the same one-thread-per-row kernel inside the runtime-counted loop; its full compiled helper retains the iteration comparison/backedge and the timed main brackets the call. The final sm86 SASS retains a row-index-versus-dim guard, rowStart/rowEnd loads, CSR-bounded load/multiply-accumulate loops including unrolled bulk and tail paths, and an output store. The synchronous D2H copy follows the launches.
